newsitem.title: UK: UK business airfares fastest rising in Europe - Amex.
newsitem.headline: UK business airfares fastest rising in Europe - Amex.

text.p: Airfares in Britain rose faster than the rest of Europe in the third quarter of 1996, according to American Express's latest European Airfares Index.
The index, based on a basket of fares, showed business class fares in Britain up seven percent on the third quarter last year, while in the rest of Europe the increase was four percent.
Business class fares on flights from Britain to North America were up nine percent on the same quarter last year, compared with an average rise of six percent in this category of fares across Europe.
